description: A member-facing self-help session for a single consumer matter (ADR-2605312500 §3, kurashimori_intake). Holds the walkthrough + checklist pulled from a chigiri template (G5 — diagnosis + drafting-assist, never legal advice/representation). CONSTITUTIONAL: member-initiated + consent + DID/SBT bound, OWN matter only (G3); the member is the named complainant (G4). Holds session metadata + checklist state, not plaintext member PII or contract content (G6).

memberDid.description: The consenting member's DID (G3); the complainant (G4)

remedyRef.description: AT-URI / rkey of the remedyTarget being pursued

templateRef.description: chigiri template id this session renders (G5 boundary)

merchantRef.description: Merchant identifier (name/handle); contract PII detail stays encrypted (G6)

consentRef.description: Reference to the member's recorded consent (G3)
